title: Sunday · Barnaby at eight
logline: The dog's middle age. The first long landscape Sunday with the dog in it: the whole beach, one walk, five tiers.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach, July, morning fog burning off, watercolor. The whole length of it. Two figures starting at the left edge: man and dog.

image.prompt: a very wide watercolor of a long Pacific Northwest beach in July morning fog burning off, two tiny figures at the far left beginning a walk, no words

panels.name: Start

panels.composition: Tier 2: a quarter of the way. The dog has found kelp. The man waits. The fog is thinner.

image.prompt: the same long beach a little further along, a small dog nosing a pile of kelp while a man waits, fog thinning, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Kelp

panels.composition: Tier 3: halfway. The dog at the surf, barking at a wave, eight years old and still doing it. The man drawing.

image.prompt: the same beach at its midpoint, a gray-muzzled dog barking at a breaking wave, a man sketching, sun through the last fog, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Wave

panels.composition: Tier 4: three-quarters. The dog slower. The man slower to match. The spruce grove ahead, lit.

image.prompt: the same beach near its end, a man and a dog walking slowly toward a sunlit spruce grove, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Slower

panels.composition: Tier 5: the end. The two of them small at the right edge, sitting on a drift log, facing the water. The whole walk above them.

image.prompt: the far end of a long beach, a man and a dog sitting together on a bleached drift log facing the water, small at the right edge of a wide watercolor tier, no words
image.notes: The drift log returns: 'The Carry' (2014) and the final page (2027).

panels.name: Log

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: Five tiers, one walk, left to right. The dog at eight. The drift log planted.
